selection_rationale: This is candidate retrieval from the registered primary seed full text (source_id seed; fulltext) and its registered bibliography/citation contexts (source_id bibliography; seed_reference_contexts). No cited-paper primary abstract or full text was available in the supplied source set or inspected; bibliography titles and contexts establish citation placement and retrieval reasons, not the cited experiments or final historical links. The existing seed extraction is reused unchanged: o_rt, o_purify, o_click and o_pcr are the only operation IDs used. Prioritize the explicitly cited functionalized-oligo chemistry, structural/biological compatibility and polymerase-interface precedents (R1-R6 and R8); the chemistry citation attached to o_click (R11); the actual previous NEBNext implementations identified by the seed (R12 and R13); and experimental failure-mode/alternative-mitigation sources (R33-R35 and R37-R39). R10 supplies a specific conventional-fragmentation implementation context. R42 is worth retrieving because it sits at the stated capture/read-through limitation, even though the seed attribution requires verification. These roles remain distinct: external chemical precedent, mechanism/background, actual assay comparison and possible component adoption are not interchangeable. No direct assay ancestor or component-adoption link is admitted at this stage. The coordinated changes described in seed [b00005]-[b00007] and [b00018] span stochastic termination without a separate fragmentation step, selective chemical adaptor joining and copying the unnatural template. No before-side operation IDs are supplied or invented. The three-part causal explanation in [b00018] is the authors’ interpretation; the whole-workflow comparison in [b00013] and artifact measurement in [b00015] do not isolate a gain for each change. Linker structure, substrate and enzyme differences must be checked in cited papers; missing routine recipe details alone need not erase a narrow conceptual precedent. R9 is a general library-construction review rather than an identified experimental precursor. R14 and R17 are used for computational analysis; R16 supplies platform error-rate context. R15 and R18-R20 concern biological findings, R22-R25 application consequences, R27-R28 chimera software and R30-R32 assembly/analysis; none has an architecture or adopted-component role established by these seed contexts. R40 is a future single-cell application context. Potentially relevant but ambiguous references are retained in unresolved_searches. No network sources, catalogue identity matches, method merges or unregistered historical references are introduced; external chemistry need not map to an Illumina catalogue entry.
